identityDecision: Retain one canonical GFL Environmental Services record and add GES and GFL Environmental Services JV LP as aliases. GES is the independent North American environmental-services platform separated from GFL effective March 1, 2025; the predecessor parent-company founding year and headquarters are not used as standalone-platform facts.
infrastructureScopeDecision: Include. Apollo's official transaction announcement says its investment used partnership capital from both Hybrid Value and Infrastructure strategies, and the operating company provides asset- and fleet-intensive liquid-waste, soil-remediation, recycling, transportation and field services across North America.

owners.vehicle: Retained equity interest in GFL Environmental Services JV LP
Apollo-managed funds; specific funds and legal vehicle not publicly disclosed
BC-managed funds; specific funds and legal vehicle not publicly disclosed
HPS-managed funds; specific funds and legal vehicle not publicly disclosed

ownershipDecision.dilutionDecision: Apollo and BC each acquired approximately 28% and GFL retained approximately 44% at the March 1, 2025 closing. HPS subscribed for approximately 22% on September 3, 2025, diluting GFL to approximately 34% and Apollo and BC to approximately 22% each.
ownershipDecision.pendingDecision: GFL's five-year call option is an option, not a signed definitive ownership change, so no pending ownership transaction is recorded.
ownershipDecision.exitSearch: No later sale, transfer or exit was identified through 2026-08-08. GFL's June 30, 2026 interim financial statements continued to carry its investment in associates and the GES call option, while BC Partners continues to list GES as an unrealised current investment.
ownershipDecision.managerOverlap: HPS Investment Partners became part of BlackRock in July 2025 but continues to operate under the HPS brand. Preserve HPS as the directly disclosed investment manager rather than replacing it with BlackRock.
